Blocked standalone trainable parameter retained for saved-graph compatibility.

**Status:** Can't run yet (Blocked): the node is listed under **Can't run yet** in the palette and cannot be added to a graph.

No model-registration, initialization, gradient, optimizer, checkpoint, or graph execution owner is registered for a standalone Parameter node.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Utility](../categories/utility.md) |
| Status | Can't run yet |
| Search words | parameter, constant, trainable |

## Inputs

None: the node starts a branch of the graph.

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Parameter** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Unregistered parameter tensor |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| shape | `shape` | Text | `256` |   | The run | Historical parameter shape. |
| init | `init` | Choice | `xavier` | `xavier`, `zeros`, `ones`, `normal`, `uniform` | The run | Historical initialization policy. |
| requires_grad | `requires_grad` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Historical gradient intent. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Parameter has no model-registration, initialization, gradient, optimizer, checkpoint, or graph execution owner |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
